# Go packages NOT tested by the CI on Windows, with their main cause, seen in
# the log of run 39478681062. See the header of windows-test-packages.txt: these
# packages are followed by the "windows-tests" batch, which makes them green and
# moves them to the list of the tested packages.
#
# Format: package, then " # cause" (one line). Same package names as
# `go list ./...`, relative to the module (cli/).
./cmd                           # fake editor/binaries written as shell scripts ("not a valid Win32 application"), team id built from a temp path that is not a slug
./internal/adapters/opencodev2  # fake servers written as shell scripts, Unix file modes (0755/0600), "/opt/oh/..." paths turned into backslashes
./internal/beads                # needs the bd binary, absent on the runner
./internal/bricks               # stack detection of the android project (TestResolveStackSkills_Projects/android) differs: file path handling
./internal/bundle               # backslash paths in the rendered annexes, shell guard tests that expect a Unix shell
./internal/config               # hub.toml saved in a temp dir is not found again, settings read back empty
./internal/daemon               # shortPaths creates its folders in /tmp (daemon_test.go:30), Unix sockets
./internal/gateway              # Beads workspace paths with backslashes, fake bd written as a shell script
./internal/gitutil              # TestSafeGitIgnoresRepoConfig: the repo config runs a shell script as fsmonitor hook
./internal/logrotate            # Unix file modes (0600 expected, 0666 given)
./internal/runsvc               # "/work/proj" paths turned into backslashes, Unix file modes, shell script fakes
./internal/runtime              # TestPathMap: inner Unix paths rewritten with backslashes (filepath)
./internal/runtime/container    # container runtime not supported on Windows, fake engine (oh-fake-engine) is a shell script
./internal/selfupdate           # self-update is unsupported on Windows (AssetName: "unsupported OS")
./internal/services/checkpoint  # runtime env with Unix paths (HOME=/home/oh), go build without GOCACHE/LocalAppData
./internal/services/report      # Unix file modes (0600/0700) not applied
./internal/services/session     # TestSubscribePollsWithoutDaemon (live_test.go:98): daemon discovery written for Unix, to analyse
./internal/services/workflow    # publication to a team-state git remote (publish_test.go:180, :303): Windows paths, to analyse
./internal/storage/filecrypt    # Unix file modes (0600 expected, 0666 given)
./internal/storage/sqlite       # Unix file modes (0600 expected, 0666 given), helper process
./internal/teamstate            # "/" separators expected in brick and claim paths
./internal/termlaunch           # tmux and terminal fakes written as shell scripts
./internal/testenv              # HOME isolation: Windows reads USERPROFILE; helper process
./internal/worktree             # "/" separators expected in sibling paths, line endings in TestStash
